messages:
sara: Hey team — PR #4921 is ready for security review. Changes touch KMS key usage for onprem deploy + small authz scope change for the inference sidecar. Link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/r-infer/pulls/4921 :eyes:

sara: TL;DR: minimize KMS key role widening, keep new env var local to private deploys, and we need to confirm no secret material is leaked to logs. Planning to merge during next maintenance window (Friday 02:00 UTC) if no blockers.

kevin: taking a look now. quick Q — the PR adds `INFER_KMS_ALIAS` to the docker env. Is that populated only in the onprem manifest?

sara: yes, it's only in onprem/helm/values.yaml and marked with `# only for onprem` comment. I moved the KMS client init under `if (process.env.ONPREM === 'true')` but wanted an extra sec review for edge cases.

anna: I can do full review in ~2 hours. Heads-up: please include a migration note for ops (how to rotate keys and fallback behavior).

jess: flagged two things after a quick scan: 1) PR changes `kms:Decrypt` policy — the resource ARN looks broader than necessary. Can we narrow to the specific key? 2) There is a helper that logs error metadata, make sure it doesn't call `JSON.stringify(err)` with the raw request context.

sara: good catches. I'll update the policy ARN to the explicit key and drop any request payload from error logs.

mike: infra note — when onprem operator sets `INFER_KMS_ALIAS` we still provision an egress rule to the KMS endpoint. Need to confirm that the helm chart doesn't accidentally open 0.0.0.0/0 for that service. I'll run a quick diff of the rendered templates.

security-bot: Auto-scan complete for PR 4921 — 1 medium finding: `aws-iam` policy contains wildcard resource. See report: https://scans.redwood.ai/reports/4921.

kevin: pinging ops (@mike) and infra leads — if we can validate the rendered `Service`/`NetworkPolicy` rules by EOD we can keep the Friday window.

anna: noted. I'll also add a tiny unit that asserts logs exclude `requestBody` for the KMS helper.

jess: once the policy ARN is tightened and the log change is in, I'm happy to approve. Also please add a short note in the PR description about the private-only env var.

sara: will do both. I'll push a fix in ~30m and request a re-run of the scan. Thanks all :thumbsup:

mike: Confirmed — helm diff didn't add broad CIDR, networkpolicy looks fine. I'll stand by to approve after the corrected IAM policy and one more scan.

kevin: FYI I'll also run a quick smoke on staging with the onprem flag to confirm no env leakage into hosted runtime.

sara: great — holding off on merge until approvals + scan cleared. If anything urgent comes up DM me.

jess: :ok_hand:
